AddOnInstructionDefinition.Name: AOI_FaultGen
AddOnInstructionDefinition.Description: Using random numbers [AOI_SIM_RNG_Simple] to generate 1-64 faults and their duration
AddOnInstructionDefinition.RevisionNote: Cfg_CycleTime changed to local tag (no need to have many configuration tags exposed)
AddOnInstructionDefinition.AdditionalHelpText:
This AOI uses Random Number ganerator to create up to 64 different outputus (BOOLs), each with different duration.
( Cfg_FaultOccurencesAll ) affects "probability" of TRUE value of all outputs ( F.x ) ( Cfg_FaultOccurences[x] ) can be used to set the ratio among "probabilities" of individual outputs ( F.x ) getting true -> higher value, haigher probability
Mechanism: - Value of the random number is between 0 and 1 - Random number is generated every ( Cfg_CycleTime ) seconds - Value of Random numebr is checked, whether it falls in interval [0 - Cfg_FaultOccurenceAll] - If Random number is in the configured interval, then this interval is split into pieces: where number of pieces to "split the interval into" is: SUM of ( Cfg_FaultOccurences[] ) ... the count of Cfg_FaultOccurences members to use is ( Cfg_NumberOfFaults ) - Each "output" (F.x) then has its "own" interval of the [0 - Cfg_FaultOccurenceAll]. If the Random number falls into the interval related to F.x, then F.x is set high - Reset of F.x to low is after a random time between ( Cfg_FaultDurationMin ) and ( Cfg_FaultDurationMax )

Parameter.Name: Cfg_NumberOfFaults
Parameter.Description: Number of faults to be generated (valid 1-64) value 0 resets the F (output) bits

LocalTag.Name: Cfg_FaultOccurences
LocalTag.Description: Each fault's "probability weight" (proportional to the other faults' "weights")
